name: Graphite (test)
author: Launcher
_about: A small test theme built on iOS 27: solid graphite surfaces instead of glass (no lens, a heavy frost, an opaque fill), a green accent, tighter corners. It exists to prove that a theme restyles the shade and home from tokens alone (design system plan, step 5). Only what differs from iOS 27 is written here.

ref.color.accents.blue.src: judged:test theme: a green accent in place of iOS's blue (every control and link that is blue turns green)

sys.material.glass.clear.src: judged:test theme: a solid graphite surface (Control Center's modules, Notification Center's platters)

sys.material.glass.frosted.src: judged:test theme: menus and sheets, solid graphite

sys.material.glass.dock.src: judged:test theme: the dock, search pill and widgets, a lighter graphite

sys.material.glass.small-active.src: judged:test theme: fields and pressed small controls

comp.cc.module.on-material.src: judged:test theme: a control that is on is the accent colour (iOS: white)

comp.cc.symbol-on-color.src: judged:test theme: white symbols on the green of a control that is on

comp.cc.symbol-color.src: judged:test theme: dark symbols on its light surfaces (iOS's Control Center is white on dark glass in both modes)

comp.cc.module.label-color.src: judged:test theme: dark names on light surfaces

comp.cc.chevron-color.src: judged:test theme: Focus's chevron on light surfaces

comp.cc.media.text-color.src: judged:test theme: the player's text on light surfaces

comp.cc.media.placeholder-color.src: judged:test theme: the music symbol on light surfaces

comp.cc.media.text-blend.src: judged:test theme: the player's text drawn as it is (iOS adds it to the dark glass: on a light surface it washed out)
